subject: Air freight HAM - HKG, must arrive by 30 Nov
body:
Hello,

please quote air freight from Hamburg (HAM) to Hong Kong (HKG) for 4 pallets of measuring instruments, 620 kg gross, 2.4 cbm. We deliver to the airport ourselves; the goods are ready on Friday 27 November.

The goods must arrive in Hong Kong no later than Monday 30 November, our customer's line stops otherwise. Within that, the cheapest option please. Price all-in in EUR.

Best regards
Jana Kraus
Logistics
Kraus Feinmechanik GmbH, Bremen
